status: Declared BEFORE this family's first run. Second pipeline; descriptive until a forward lane. Honest caveat: the same history was already used by intraday_v1 (whose unconditional delayed entries all lost), so the forward shadow lane is the real judge.
question: Can buying only after the first minutes CONFIRM the move reduce downside pain on frozen D's trades without giving away a statistically meaningful amount of return?
trades: the traded top 3 of frozen D (primary) and of the ensemble (reported), from intraday_v1's frozen candidate set; entry sessions must reconcile (intraday_v1 rule)
rule_form: At checkpoint minute k (3, 6, 15, 30 after 09:15): if the signal is TRUE using only bars up to minute k (and the pick day's bars for warm-up and levels), buy at the last trade by minute k (or the first trade after k if none yet); otherwise SKIP (cash). WAIT form: buy at the first 3-minute checkpoint up to minute 30 where the signal is true; otherwise skip. Exit unchanged: the 5th close (honest circuit exits). 35 bp.

signals.HIGHER_LOW: no trade below the first bar's low since it (needs 2+ bars)
signals.UPPER_HALF: price in the upper half of the range so far
signals.RSI_ABOVE_50: RSI(14) on 3-minute closes (pick day + today so far) > 50
signals.MACD_UP: MACD(12,26) above its 9-signal on the same 3-minute closes
signals.EARLY_VOLUME: volume so far >= 2 x (k / 375) x the 20-session average daily volume (daily cache)
signals.BUY_PRESSURE: more than half of the volume so far on up-bars (close > open)
signals.NIFTY_UP: NIFTY 50 at or above its own open
signals.BEAT_NIFTY: the stock's return since the open > NIFTY 50's
signals.GAP2_CONFIRM: if the gap is at least +2%: buy at minute k only if HOLD_OPEN, else skip; if the gap is smaller: buy at the open

rules: every signal at k = 3, 6, 15, 30 plus its WAIT form: 19 x 5 = 95 rules, listed in full by confirmation_study.RULES

metrics_per_rule.strategy_delta: per signal day, mean over the day's trades of (rule net if confirmed, else 0) minus the open-entry net - the return test
metrics_per_rule.confirmed_delta: per day, mean over confirmed trades of rule net minus their own open-entry net (did waiting improve the trades taken)
metrics_per_rule.skipped_delta: per day, mean over skipped trades of minus their open-entry net (what skipping saved (+) or cost (-))
metrics_per_rule.mae_delta: per day, mean over confirmed trades of (MAE from the rule's entry) minus (MAE from the open); MAE = deepest low through the exit vs the entry price; positive = shallower
metrics_per_rule.worst10_delta: 10th-percentile net of the trades the rule takes minus the 10th-percentile open-entry net of all trades

judging.return_winner: strategy_delta: discovery survivor under Benjamini-Hochberg (q 0.10, across the 95 rules) AND confirmation window same sign with 95% lower bound > 0
judging.pain_winner: ALL of: mae_delta a discovery survivor under its own Benjamini-Hochberg (q 0.10) and confirmation 95% lower bound > 0; worst10_delta 95% lower bound > 0 in both windows; strategy_delta NOT significantly negative in either window (95% upper bound >= 0); retention >= 50% in both windows
judging.guardrail: lower drawdown alone never qualifies; skipping trades never counts as pain reduction (MAE is measured on trades taken)
judging.lanes: only D's winners become forward shadow lanes; the ensemble's are reported
